en.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
en.description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000/year to eligible farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 directly into bank accounts.
en.eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families (cultivable landholding) as per land records; excludes institutional landholders, higher-income categories.
en.benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year direct transfer; supports farm input costs.
application_steps: Verify and submit; note registration number.
Instalments credited to bank account; check status online.
faqs: How do I register for PM-KISAN?
Why is my PM-KISAN payment pending?
How do I do PM-KISAN e-KYC?
